description: Reviewed immutable digests for the microVM qualification lane images. A claimed lane must pull exactly these bytes — never whatever a mutable tag resolves to at run time. Digests are per-architecture: apple-hypervisor-framework runs on arm64 (macos-15), linux-kvm on amd64 (ubuntu-latest). Refresh by resolving the tag's manifest list at review time and recording the per-architecture digest.
